summary: Short kerb where cars park, beside a workshop and car yard, no homes near.
reasons: Workshop and yard behind, no dwellings

drivers.seclusion: East side is a grass strip then a commercial workshop 15 m back and a yard; no mapped dwelling nearby, the closest house in imagery is about 35 m south.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb with a grass verge; cars are parked here in both images, so the lane has room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street off Witton Road serving businesses.
drivers.convention: White and blue cars parked on this kerb, so a van will not stand out; 2P applies Mon-Fri 9am-6pm and Sat to noon only.

flags: Low-lying: about 6.5 m elevation, Witton Creek 43 m away
Section is only about one van length
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree canopy to the south shades the lower end.
cannot_judge: Whether the workshop has night activity

best_section.where: East kerb of Rennies Road, in front of the grassy strip by the metal-clad workshop
